Another historical reference to the name Bashash is found in the context of the 13th century Mongol invasion of the Islamic world. The name Bashash is mentioned in the memoirs of the Mongol general Subutai, who led the Mongol army to defeat the Islamic forces at the Battle of Ain Jalut in 1260. Bashash is described as being a Muslim leader who fought against the Mongols and was killed in the battle.
